# Local paper PDFs (not in git)

The PDFs in this folder are **gitignored**: the arXiv versions are under arXiv's default license, which doesn't allow us to republish them in a public repo. Each one is linked from a note in `wiki/papers/`.

To make the links work on a new machine, download them into this folder with exactly these names:

| File name | Download |
|---|---|
| `zhang-2017-53-ion-dpt-arxiv-1708.01044.pdf` | https://arxiv.org/pdf/1708.01044v2 |
| `omalley-2016-h2-molecular-energies-arxiv-1512.06860.pdf` | https://arxiv.org/pdf/1512.06860v2 |
| `kandala-2017-hardware-efficient-vqe-arxiv-1704.05018.pdf` | https://arxiv.org/pdf/1704.05018v2 |
